question: Which sanctuary has the largest number of one-horned Rhinoceros as on June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaziranga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kaziranga National Park** is located in the state of Assam, India.
 
• It is renowned for having the largest population of the **Indian one-horned rhinoceros** in the world.
 
• As of June 2022, Kaziranga houses approximately **2,400 one-horned rhinoceroses**.
 
• Kaziranga is recognized as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** due to its significant biodiversity and conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary**

 
 
• Located in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is known for its population of tigers, leopards, and elephants.
 
• It is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.
 
 
 
• **Kanha National Park**
 
 
• Situated in Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• Famous for its tiger reserve and efforts in tiger conservation.
 
• Home to the Barasingha or swamp deer.
 
 
 
• **Sariska Wildlife Sanctuary**
 
 
• Located in Rajasthan, India.
 
• Known for its population of Bengal tigers.
 
• It was declared a tiger reserve in 1978.
 
 
 
• **One-horned Rhinoceros**
 
 
• Also known as the Indian rhinoceros (Rhinoceros unicornis).
 
• Primarily found in the grasslands and forests of Assam and Nepal.
 
• Recognized for its single black horn and a grey-brown hide with skin folds.
 
• Conservation efforts have led to a significant increase in their population over recent decades.
